git fetch --quiet origin main
gh pr list --state open --base main --author app/github-actions --limit 100 --json number,headRefName,createdAt,labels,url,isCrossRepository
gh pr view 25 --json headRefOid,statusCheckRollup
git fetch --quiet origin main +refs/heads/update/dead-check-1:refs/remotes/origin/update/dead-check-1
git rev-parse origin/update/dead-check-1
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main 2500000000000000000000000000000000000000
git switch --quiet -C update/dead-check-1 2500000000000000000000000000000000000000
git rebase --quiet origin/main
git rev-parse HEAD
dispatch-ci update/dead-check-1 https://github.com/o/r/pull/25
git fetch --quiet origin +refs/heads/update/dead-check-1:refs/remotes/origin/update/dead-check-1
git rev-parse origin/update/dead-check-1
gh pr view 25 --json state,labels
git push --quiet origin 2500000000000000000000000000000000000000:refs/heads/main
git rev-parse --short 2500000000000000000000000000000000000000
git fetch --quiet origin main
gh pr view 25 --json state --jq .state
git push --quiet origin --delete update/dead-check-1
gh pr view 24 --json headRefOid,statusCheckRollup
git fetch --quiet origin main +refs/heads/update/no-checks-1:refs/remotes/origin/update/no-checks-1
git rev-parse origin/update/no-checks-1
git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main 2400000000000000000000000000000000000000
git switch --quiet -C update/no-checks-1 2400000000000000000000000000000000000000
git rebase --quiet origin/main
git rev-parse HEAD
dispatch-ci update/no-checks-1 https://github.com/o/r/pull/24

git rev-parse origin/update/no-checks-1
gh pr view 24 --json state,labels
git push --quiet origin 2400000000000000000000000000000000000000:refs/heads/main
git rev-parse --short 2400000000000000000000000000000000000000
git fetch --quiet origin main
gh pr view 24 --json state --jq .state
git push --quiet origin --delete update/no-checks-1
gh workflow run ci.yml --ref main
